name: Bloodsuckers
source:
Bloodsuckers is a linear furry visual novel that melds love, loss, and murder. Bare the fangs of tiger and vampire Elias as he infiltrates a mysterious compound, his mind centered on one thing. The Hunt.

TONIGHT HE WILL KILL.

He remembers the Hunt. It comes back to him so easily. So simply. The chase. The guilt. The ecstasy. 

Elias had sworn-off this part of himself. Renounced it long ago. Made a promise. But it's different tonight, he tells himself. His muscles are weak. His fur graying. Starving. Always starving. He doesn't need much. Just a little. Just enough.

BLOOD CHANGES YOU.

The parking lot is empty. He slips between the streetlights. The cameras don't see. The shadows are his friends. They tell him things. When to go. Where. He climbs the fence. He finds the window. And then he's inside.

The Hunt is on.

[From [url=https://kraajlanding.itch.io/bloodsuckers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《吸血者》是一部融合了爱、失落和谋杀的线性毛茸茸视觉小说。当他潜入一个神秘的建筑时，老虎和吸血鬼埃利亚斯露出了獠牙，他的注意力集中在一件事上。狩猎。

今晚他会杀人。

他记得狩猎。他很容易就想起了这一点。就这么简单。追逐。罪孽。狂喜。

埃利亚斯发誓放弃了自己的这一部分。早就放弃了。做出了承诺。但今晚不一样，他告诉自己。他的肌肉很虚弱。他的皮毛变灰了。挨饿了。总是挨饿。他不需要太多。只是一点点。就够了。

血液改变你。

停车场是空的。他在路灯之间滑行。相机看不到。影子是他的朋友。他们告诉他一些事情。什么时候去。在哪里。他爬上栅栏。他找到了窗户。然后他就进去了。

狩猎开始了。

[来自[url=https://kraajlanding.itch.io/bloodsuckers]Itch.io[/url]]
